continuity: Taekyung leaves immediately with Jeok Cheongang for a year of martial-arts training in Anhui.
Jin Wikyung entrusts Taekyung to Jeok and has an important private matter to discuss with Jeok before their departure.
Taekyung tells Jin Mukyung that he and Cheongpung will attend the Star-Array Grand Banquet in one year.

Jin Mukyung trains in an unlit cave with ten thousand daily sword strikes, no internal energy, and one hundred additional strikes for each mistake; his defeat by Cheongpung remains the impetus for his training.

Cheongpung claims Mae Jonghak has given permission for him to become Jeok Cheongang’s Disciple and follow Taekyung, though Baek Museong questions how he obtained permission while Mae has been missing for over a month.
Baek Museong plans either to escort Cheongpung back to Huashan or search the Central Plains for Mae Jonghak, and will leave when Huashan sends a message.
Hyuk Mujin packed Taekyung’s travel luggage at Jin Wikyung’s order; Wolhwa learned of the departure through the Lower District Sect.
Taekyung warned Chulwoo not to make advances toward Eunhyang, and Chulwoo agreed.
Lee Seowol asked Taekyung to call her Young Lady rather than Sect Leader during their farewell.
plot: Jin Taekyung decides to leave immediately with Jeok Cheongang for a year of martial-arts training in Anhui. Jin Wikyung entrusts Taekyung to Jeok and privately reserves an important discussion with him before departure.

Jin Mukyung continues an exacting training regimen in isolation, performing ten thousand sword strikes without internal energy and adding one hundred strikes for every mistake. Taekyung tells him that he and Cheongpung will attend the Star-Array Grand Banquet in one year, prompting Mukyung to regain his composure and resume a perfect strike.

Hyuk Mujin, Cheongpung, Wolhwa, Lee Seowol, and the Three Plum Blossom Elites gather at the main gate to see Taekyung off. Cheongpung claims Mae Jonghak has permitted him to become Jeok’s Disciple and follow Taekyung; Baek Museong plans either to escort Cheongpung back to Huashan or search the Central Plains for Mae’s whereabouts. Taekyung reconciles with Chulwoo while warning him not to make advances toward Eunhyang, and Lee Seowol asks Taekyung to address her as Young Lady rather than Sect Leader. Jeok then seizes Taekyung and departs with him while Jin Wikyung tearfully wishes him a safe return.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Over-one-hundred-year-old wandering martial master and the Fire King; he visits Jang Taebo’s home, can detect Qi Sense, can cross more than ten jang in an instant, plans to reach Taiyuan and visit the Lower District Sect while concealing his identity, and once fought Sword Saint Mae Jonghak for seven days and seven nights to a draw at Mount Jiuhua before emerging from seclusion and annihilating one thousand Demonic Cultists there; after striking Jin Taekyung with the Flame Divine Palm, he deduces that Taekyung took the Blazing Flame Divine Pill and confronts him when he tries to flee the inn; he reaches the Jin Family of Taiyuan, falsely identifies the Unnamed Sword in public as the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure entrusted to Taekyung, later reveals that it is actually the Fire Heaven Sword, the beloved sword of the Fire Gate Clan’s tenth Sect Leader, uses Six-Harmonies Voice Transmission to stop Song Il, publicly humiliates him, then follows the departing Zhongnan group, incapacitates the Three Hands, breaks Song Il’s wrist, strikes him with the Flame Divine Palm, and threatens to destroy the Zhongnan Sect and Mount Zhongnan if Taekyung or the Jin Family is harmed; two days later, he severely beats Taekyung with his bare fists over the partly burned Flame Divine Palm manual, performs an abbreviated cleansing treatment on Taekyung, discovers his exceptionally balanced body, and suspects he may possess the legendary Heavenly Martial Physique; at the Jin Family banquet, after Ak Bulgun questions their relationship, he publicly declares himself the eighteenth Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan, accepts Taekyung as his Disciple, and declares that Taekyung will inherit the clan’s orthodox lineage; he identifies Taekyung as possessing the Heavenly Martial Physique, agrees to personally oversee Taekyung’s martial-arts training until Taekyung reaches a certain level, and permits Taekyung to address him as Master publicly and Old Master in private while continuing to deny that they are truly master and Disciple; after accepting Taekyung’s challenge to defend only, he is forced five steps backward by Taekyung’s One Annihilation and admits defeat, then supports Taekyung with internal energy as he collapses; impressed by the strike, he now desires to guide Taekyung toward becoming a Heavenly Dragon; he successfully forces open Taekyung’s Conception and Governor Vessels, then carries the unconscious Taekyung away to rest after the ordeal; he waits through Taekyung’s seven-day unconscious recovery, explains that removing accumulated turbid qi caused the adjustment period, discusses the Star-Array Grand Banquet invitation, and asks Taekyung to visit his quarters at dawn after hearing Taekyung’s desire to pursue greater strength.
